aspect: Infrastructure failure is a productivity tax before it is anything else
description: Power, connectivity, transport and water each fail unpredictably, and each failure is absorbed by rescheduling the work around it. The output loss is never attributed to the grid.
energy_note: Losing a morning to the generator, weekly.

aspect: Administrative load is a second unpaid job
description: Passports, visas, verifications, appeals, bank reviews, utility disputes. Days per year, every year, drawn from the same hours as the career.
time_note: Days per year on the administration of the hurdles in this file.
energy_note: A second job, unpaid, with no promotion in it.

aspect: Threat monitoring runs on the same budget as thinking
description: Sustained vigilance about security, money and status consumes the attention that would go to work. The capacity is finite and already committed.
energy_note: Concentration spent before the day begins.

aspect: Sleep goes first, and everything is downstream of sleep
description: Generators, heat, night-time power windows, the folder of pending applications. Degraded sleep degrades judgement, mood and output invisibly.
energy_note: Everything else, downstream of not sleeping.

aspect: The result is scored as a character trait
description: Reduced output is appraised by employers, universities and families as laziness or unreliability. The person receives that judgement and frequently agrees with it.
energy_note: Judged for capacity that was already spent.

aspect: Which closes the loop of this entire dataset
description: Conditions are imposed. The conditions reduce output. The reduced output is read as evidence about the person and about Nigerians. That evidence is then used to justify the conditions - the visa refusal, the extra verification, the blocked payment.
energy_note: Made unable, then blamed for it, then restricted because of it.

description: Power went at 04:00. The inverter is flat, so the generator runs from 07:00, so the fuel needs buying, so the queue, so the deliverable that was due at noon is sent at 16:40 with an apology. Her client in Berlin has no framework for any of this and records her as unreliable.
energy_note: A morning lost to fuel, filed abroad as unreliability.

description: The conditions reduce the output. The reduced output is read as a fact about Nigerians. That reading justifies the visa refusal in VIS-001, the extra verification in REP-003 and the blocked payment in FIN-002 - each of which costs more time, and reduces the output further.
energy_note: Made unable, blamed for it, and restricted because of the blame.
